visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) High-angle view of a dark gray camper van with its pop-top roof extended, parked on a light gray gravel surface under the shade of a large, leafy tree with multiple thick branches. A black mountain bike is propped against a stone wall next to the tree. The background shows dry grass and a hint of a misty mountain range. (2) Drone shot sweeping over a majestic coastline where a wide, sandy beach meets the clear, turquoise-blue ocean. Lush, bright green hills rise steeply from the shore under a pale blue sky with light clouds. Driftwood and scattered debris are visible on the sand near the water's edge. (3) Top-down aerial view of a coastal road winding through a small settlement with colorful rooftops. A river mouth cuts through the sandy beach, carrying dark sediment into the ocean. Large gray rocks and a concrete embankment line the edge of the water near the houses. (4) Extreme high-angle shot looking straight down at the shoreline where rhythmic, white-capped waves crash onto the dark sand and pebbles. The water transitions from a shallow tan to a vibrant, deep turquoise as it recedes into the ocean, creating a dynamic visual pattern. (5) Wide-angle panoramic drone shot capturing the curvature of the bay. On the left, a rocky cliff with a small lookout wall is populated by several small human figures. The beach extends far into the distance, framed by a series of rolling green mountains shrouded in light haze. (6) Dynamic tracking shot from behind a cyclist wearing a light-colored jersey and dark shorts, riding a black bike along a smooth, two-lane asphalt road. The road curves sharply along the base of a massive, verdant cliff face covered in dense tropical vegetation and tall grasses. (7) Drone view of a man-made harbor or inlet protected by layers of gray concrete tetrapods. The water inside the harbor is a strikingly bright turquoise color. Small buildings and green hills are visible in the background, with waves breaking against the outer breakwater rocks. (8) Sweeping cinematic aerial footage of the rugged coastline where the winding road sits between the base of steep green mountains and the rocky shore. The blue ocean extends to the horizon, with waves creating white foam as they hit the jagged rocks along the coast.
